title: Review fixes, Major: delivery day, Scout and Undo, online dead ends (REP-122)
problem: REP-122 found nine Major problems; the owner chose to fix eight (S1 goes with Closing Day in PLAN-108).
scope: S2: on a standing order's due day the order's pieces count as wanted, Auto load loads them, and the row says who they are for
S3: Undo takes back purchases only; a favour card once played stays played (owner's option)
ON-01: quick matches keep upgrades (owner's option): RULES.md and the room's code comment say so; the game does not change
ON-02: Create a room forgets a used invite
ON-03: an unknown or expired room code says so, with a way back
ON-04: a rematch counts only the people still there and says who left
ON-05: a disconnected lobby seat is freed after the usual wait, and the host is told who is disconnected
ON-06: invite links from the Android app use the game's real address
exclusions: Any change to prices, cards or scoring
A real Android phone check (NOT RUN until the owner has one at hand)

added: Room server: a code with no room is answered with a message that stops the phone ("That room doesn't exist or has closed. Check the code.", or "That room has closed." for a phone that was in it)
Room server: a private lobby frees a seat whose person has been away for the grace period (75 s); the host's button names who is away, with a countdown
Results online: who has left, and a computer plays for them in a rematch
Undo button label "after Scout" (or the card played) and a warning on the favour card before it is played
changed: A rematch waits only for the people still connected; a seat whose person has gone is played by the computer and can be taken back with the seat token
Undo on a buying turn goes back to just after the last favour card played (DEC-120): the card, what it showed and earlier purchases stay; offline and in the room server
Invite links are built from the game's web address whenever the page is not served from it (the Android app)
An invite link is read once and taken out of the address; leaving the online screen forgets it
RULES.md: quick matches keep upgrades (a dated note on the rules 8 history); the room's settings comment says so
ONLINE.md: rematch, lobby, unknown rooms and invite links
